DeepSeek Harness agents finish or need you. Plus a full chat, live session board and an edge hinge.

NeoXider Agent Deck
Your agents, within reach. And a slime that lives on your desktop.
A desktop chat for DeepSeek Harness, a live session board, a little pet that climbs your screen, or
just a glowing hinge.
Download · Meet the pet · Get started · What's new · Security
Agent Deck brings DeepSeek Harness onto your desktop. Follow several agents at once, carry on a conv
ersation, change models, answer an agent's question and share a screenshot without leaving what you
are doing. Fold the chat away when you need the room and a green slime keeps you company instead: it
tells you when an agent finishes, asks you when one needs you, and spends the rest of its time clim
bing, hopping and napping around your screen.
## Meet the pet
Fold the widget and it becomes a slime. The slime is a proper desktop pet, built the way the classic
s are (Shimeji, eSheep, oneko): a small state machine picks its next move by weight, gravity is real
, and it rests far more than it moves.

Its glow is its own silhouette in the colour of what the agents are doing. Hover it and three little
buttons appear: recent chats, **status** (the eye: every message the agent writes, or only finished
replies), and folding into the screen edge. Pet mode can be switched off in **Settings → Pet mode**
; the slime then stays put at its edge.

These are screenshots of the UI with demonstration sessions. Avatar and Hinge are called Orb and Edg
e in some internal settings and diagnostics. Hover the hinge and a little slime peeks out above it:
click it to become the avatar again.
## Small window. Full conversation.
- **Answer the agent here.** When an agent stops on a question, it appears above the message box wit
h its options. Answer or skip without opening the browser, or fold it into one line for now to read

the chat under it, and open it again when you are ready.
- **Chats from the avatar.** Click a recent
chat to address the message box to it; click it again and the chat opens right in the panel, its ne
west messages above the same message box, so you read the answer and reply without leaving the slime

. The arrow beside a chat opens the full chat.
- **Subagents in sight.** The chip under the Thinking
line counts subagents and background jobs as working/total (`Subagents 2/29 · Jobs 1/3`); open it t
o see each one working, stop it, read a job's output, or open a subagent as a chat of its own and wr

ite to it.
- **Fast on long chats.** A chat opens on its newest messages and fetches older ones as y
ou scroll; a chat of thousands of messages opens in a fraction of a second, and one you opened befor

e is back instantly.
- **Open what the chat points at.** Click an image, an attached file, a link to
a file or a path an agent writes, and it opens in a viewer window: images to zoom, Markdown to read

, code highlighted at the line named.
- **What it cost.** Hover the context meter: spend and cost pe
r turn, context and what fills it, turns and tool calls, tokens and cache hits, time worked. A chat'
s spend includes its subagents, every level down, each at its own model's price, and the card splits
it into the chat and its subagents. A subagent's chat shows the same in its bar. A local build of a
listed model (Qwen3.8 Flash in LM Studio, say) is priced as that model; any other local model is fr

ee.
- **Pin, delete, undo.** Pin a chat to the top of its group or delete it from its card's menu; d

eleting archives it the way DSH does, and Undo brings it back.
- **One model and effort control.** O

pen the combined chip, adjust reasoning on the slider, or choose another model from the same menu.
